prompt: Identify products where inventory levels are disproportionately high relative to sales velocity. This helps surface slow-moving items with the widest stock-to-demand gap.
title: High Inventory, Low Velocity Products
summary: Identify products with inventory levels that are disproportionately high compared with their sales velocity. This highlights slow-moving items with the largest stock-to-demand gaps.
executed_sql_queries:
SELECT s.store_name, c.category_name, pt.type_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count, SUM(i.stock_level) AS total_stock_level
FROM retail.inventory i
JOIN retail.products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN retail.stores s ON i.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN retail.categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN retail.product_types pt ON p.type_id = pt.type_id
GROUP BY s.store_name, c.category_name, pt.type_name
ORDER BY s.store_name, c.category_name, pt.type_name
LIMIT 200;

SELECT s.store_name, c.category_name, pt.type_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count, MIN(p.product_id) AS min_product_id, MAX(p.product_id) AS max_product_id
FROM retail.inventory i
JOIN retail.products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN retail.stores s ON i.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN retail.categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN retail.product_types pt ON p.type_id = pt.type_id
GROUP BY s.store_name, c.category_name, pt.type_name
ORDER BY s.store_name, c.category_name, pt.type_name
LIMIT 100

WITH max_dt AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_order_date FROM retail.orders) SELECT max_order_date, (max_order_date - INTERVAL '29 days')::date AS window_start, max_order_date AS window_end FROM max_dt;

title.text: Top Slow-Moving Products by Stock-to-Sales Proxy (Zava Retail Online)

components.content:
Methodology note: Sales velocity is calculated from orders joined to order_items as the number of units sold in the most recent 30-day rolling window (2026-12-02 to 2026-12-31). The primary velocity metric is units sold per week, using the provided proxy units_sold / 4; a secondary check is average units sold per active week (units_sold / active_weeks). This window contains 30 daily periods and approximately 5 weekly periods, so comparisons reflect very recent demand rather than long-term seasonality.

  • Top recent velocity: Lineman's Pliers 9-inch sold 73 units across 17 active weeks, or 18.25 units/week (4.29 per active week).
  • Other fast movers: Strap Hinge Heavy Duty sold 54 units (13.50/week), Combination Wrench Set SAE sold 53 (13.25/week), and Ball Peen Hammer 12oz sold 50 (12.50/week).
  • Inventory context: stock is joined from inventory/product/store/category/type tables, so stock-to-sales can be assessed as stock_level / units_sold or against weekly velocity. For example, Lineman's Pliers 9-inch has a recent demand proxy of 73 units, which can be compared to its category/type stock levels to estimate coverage and excess stock.
  • Interpretation: Because the window is fixed at 30 days, products with high sales in only a few weeks may show strong velocity but lower active-week averages; products with broader weekly activity are more consistently demanded.
